notes.title: Kickstarter now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello! Our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/puzzlab/detective-ridelle]Kickstarter page[/url] is now live! A huge thank you to everyone who has supported us so far. 

Check out the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/puzzlab/detective-ridelle]Kickstarter page[/url] now to see a brand new trailer, snag an early copy and even get your name in the credits!

Josh :)

notes.title: Happy Valentine's Day!
notes.notes:
Happy Valentine's Day to all you puzzle lovers out there!

Yes, it's one of the sillier holidays, but what a great excuse to post a little update and share some amazing artwork with you guys.

Development is coming along very well, and we've begun testing. The feedback has been fantastic so far. I'm quietly confident that we'll be able to get the game in your hands sooner rather than later. I'm currently aiming for a June/July release.

If you're interested in the next round of testing, please join our Discord server - there's a link on the store page.

There's so much I'd like to share but I'm hoping to save as many puzzles, mysteries and little secrets as possible for the full release.

Thank you to everyone who's wishlisted - the support has been truly staggering. If you're interested in following development a little more closely, please follow our twitter: https://twitter.com/PuzzLabGames

See below for the full size art of our lovely protagonists Ridelle and Lucy by the amazingly talented Rakkigaru.

Stay tuned for more info soon! Until then,
Lots of love ♥

Josh

notes.title: Detective Ridelle is now announced!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Ridelle's strange world of escape room puzzles and murder mysteries!

We're so excited to finally announce this game to the world. Keep an eye out as development progresses for updates and sneak peaks before release.

Development is progressing smoothly and we expect a full release sooner rather than later. No official release date yet but we're currently aiming for a release in the next 6 months.

So stay tuned, and stay excited!

-Josh
